set.body:
Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 4 of 6; child 7 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Deliver standalone HTML and application mounting with responsive/fixed sizing, configurable toolbar, selection/navigation controls, fullscreen, PNG export, rich presentation, and dependency/resource packaging. Preserve ordinary static export.

Acceptance criteria
1. A saved artifact works without an application server and includes or explicitly packages the required runtime/assets; two embedded widgets remain independent.
2. Toolbar location, fixed/floating visibility, and individual controls are configurable and keyboard accessible; selection/zoom/reset/fullscreen/download controls work.
3. Responsive resize and device scale changes keep rendering, picking, overlays, and focus aligned; configured fonts are respected.
4. Export explicitly selects original versus current viewport/selection state and produces the corresponding PNG; static SVG/PDF/raster output requires no interaction runtime.
5. Publish a runnable standalone example and a framework-neutral controlled-state example, with actionable errors for unavailable browser capabilities or failed exports.

Exclusions
Mandatory Shiny support or a reactive-framework dependency in core; optional framework adapters remain outside the baseline.

Required evidence
Actual standalone-file and application-browser tests, rendered export inspection, resize/device-scale traces, and documented asset/dependency closure.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B2AVT76SH1WGF905D5D3, bd-01M1Z9B2R9HSG6QJRA0JTR875X

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 07] Package standalone interactive HTML and configurable browser controls
